title: Java orders API
scope: The orders HTTP API and its write path: OrderController, OrderService, the JPA entities/repository and the order-created event published through the messaging provider. /chaos and /topology are out of scope.
hints: OrderService persists through OrderRepository (Spring Data / JPA table orders).
OrderCreatedEvent is published by OrdersEventHandler; the provider is in-memory by default and SQS or RabbitMQ when configured.
Payload classes under web/payload are the wire contract; entities under entities are the storage shape.
rubric: GET and POST /orders are separate input contracts. The orders table is storage; the published order-created event is a queue boundary. The in-memory messaging and persistence providers are defaults, so describing SQS or PostgreSQL as always-on is inaccurate.
